name: orchestra
description: Multi-agent orchestra for Claude Code: routes each part of a task to the best-fit, cheapest model among Claude subagents and external CLI agents (Codex, Antigravity/Gemini, OpenCode, Copilot, Kimi), guards shared files, lets agents talk on a shared board, relays long messages through Haiku, runs a lean efficiency mode, and shows plan usage, context, files and agent conversations in one pane
